heading: About
bio: Hi, I'm Ron. 17 years as a software developer, 2.5 years behind the decks — and it's been a wild, rewarding ride. What started as a passion project turned into something people actually book me for. At the end of the day, I do this for the joy, the love, and the pure passion of watching a crowd come alive, wherever the party is — a hall, a backyard, a rooftop, or a pool party. I work closely with everyone who books me to tailor the night exactly to their event, at prices that stay fair and accessible. I bring the same care I put into code into every set: reading the room, staying organized, and making sure the tech never gets in the way of the night.
